pairs.subject: silver-medalist-rediscovery
pairs.evidence: app/_lib/rediscover.ts:114 pickPrior still lets in people whose other-role entry is live (status active) or who reached Hired. The taxonomy puts both groups out of scope, so the Rediscover panel and the alert feed can pitch a role to someone mid-process elsewhere or to your own hire, and rediscover.test.ts:124 pins that behaviour.

techniques.evidence: app/_lib/rediscover.ts:114 'Currently in process' and 'Hired' are ineligible classes. Here they get an 'elsewhere' kind. Also, a person with a rejected prior who is now active in another role is still surfaced as 'rejected', because nothing excludes live candidates as a group. The rest holds: the lookup is tenant-scoped (candidateOutcomes(opts.workspaceId)), the role_closed/declined values match what the writer emits, and a row with no prior is dropped.

app/_lib/rediscovery-rank.ts:26 Half of the 10-point tier step. priorDepthBoost is clamped to [0, band]. The comparator (rank.ts:54) keeps the honest score as the tiebreak, the displayed score stays honest, and rank.test.ts:44 asserts the band guarantee arithmetically. Active 'elsewhere' rows get depth 0 (rediscover.ts:119), but per the taxonomy they should not be ranked at all.

app/_lib/rediscover.ts:200 Admission uses the raw score, before any boost. SCORE_FLOOR = FIT_PROMISING_FLOOR (rediscover.ts:28), which the pool-fit filter also uses with >=. The Python total is already an integer (matching.py round), so Math.round does not fork the comparator at the boundary. The consent gate runs before the floor (rediscover.ts:157).

app/_lib/rediscovery-relevance.ts:49 Consent is collapsed per candidate: anonymisation is terminal, grants union to the latest expiry, and opt-out is merged person-wide in withheldCandidateIds. The 'never granted' and 'lapsed' states stay distinct. A read error suppresses everyone and logs it (rediscovery-alert-store.ts:471). The gate runs before ranking (rediscover.ts:157) and also guards the write, the feed read and the outreach door.

app/_lib/rediscover.ts:326 At read time the feed re-checks only role-published, presence in the target role, and the consent gate. It does not re-check hired or active elsewhere, does not re-run the fit floor, and does not re-run the sweep predicate (pickPrior). There is also no staleness horizon short of the 90-day prune. On the plus side, sweep truncation is bounded, rotated and logged (rediscover.ts:474), and the result cap reports `more`.
